input.subject: Usopp
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Kabuto/Black Kabuto sniper, multiple Pop Greens with distinct documented behavior, traps and Observation awakening. Long-range precision and plant lane control. No invented continuous Haki mastery, free flying, or magical damage aura. Named plants must correspond to implemented behavior. Sogeking is a persona, not a supernatural transformation. Use the new targeted weapon and ability research to preserve named, behaviorally distinct Wano-canon Pop Greens and Kuro Kabuto growth. The supplied pages were freshly acquired by the orchestration CLI in this campaign; do not misstate fresh research as unavailable. Continuous reliable Observation sensing is a disclosed game abstraction of Dressrosa awakening, not established repeated canonical mastery. Do not rename Haki sensing to ordinary eyesight merely to evade a fidelity gap. Document and bound its unlock/targeting semantics honestly.
